identity.meaning: MVP is the minimum verified operating state of the final PPR machine, not a separate prototype.

checkpoints.name: RECEIPT_IDENTITY_SMOKE
checkpoints.purpose: Identify received/owned parts, ratings, visible damage and exact evidence before fabrication.

checkpoints.name: COLD_GEOMETRY_MOTION_SMOKE
checkpoints.purpose: Use the final frame/hot-path hardware for fit, travel, hand rotation, TIR/alignment and guard-envelope checks.

checkpoints.name: LOGIC_SAFETY_SMOKE
checkpoints.purpose: Exercise final K0/interlock/PE/logic wiring before hazardous branch power.
stop_on: K0 does not drop on required open

checkpoints.name: SINGLE_AXIS_DRIVE_SMOKE
checkpoints.purpose: Commission the final GGM drive path at bounded speed/current with heaters isolated.

checkpoints.name: THERMAL_BARRIER_TAPE_SMOKE
checkpoints.purpose: Qualify TH-INS-01 identity, adhesive/backing thermal behavior and installation rule before relying on it as a final thermal barrier.

checkpoints.name: EMPTY_HOT_ZONE_SMOKE
checkpoints.purpose: Commission the final empty hot zone with motors inhibited, including TH-INS-01 after S4 qualification.
stop_on: cutoff fails to remove K0 energy

steps: preserve raw evidence and exact hardware configuration
identify earliest affected P-stage and controlling digital sources
modify CAD/BOM/electrical/firmware only through repository source-of-truth
regenerate affected release artifacts and rerun digital validators
invalidate downstream physical stage releases whose source bindings changed
rework the same final hardware where safe and technically valid, otherwise replace only the affected final component
repeat the failed smoke checkpoint before proceeding
